zh.summary: 依照使用者當下的決策安排資訊：主畫面保留必要欄位、檢核結果與復原方法，次要設定延後展開。
objectives: 區分可延後呈現的設定與必須直接顯示的工作狀態。
為輸入、處理中、缺漏及完成狀態設計下一步。
用同儕任務觀察檢查介面簡化是否真的有幫助。

sections.heading: 主畫面要幫使用者做哪個決定
paragraphs: 收件人員打開檢核網站，當下要決定的是資料能否交接。他需要看到必要欄位、檢查按鈕、缺漏與修正方式，以及完成後的預覽。輪詢間隔、除錯輸出與模型參數通常不影響這個工作決定，可以放在次要設定或教學開發環境。
但「處理中」影響他是否應再次點擊，「失敗」影響他是否需要重試，這些資訊要直接顯示。簡化畫面時，先畫出使用者要做的決定，再安排資訊位置。

sections.heading: 像自助取票機的主要畫面
paragraphs: 取票時，你需要選目的地、張數並知道付款是否完成。機器維護者可能需要交易紀錄與連線診斷；把兩者一起攤在首頁，乘客就得從大量無關資訊中尋找下一步。反過來，如果機器把付款失敗也藏進設定，乘客可能不知道是否已扣款。
漸進揭露是將較少使用或較複雜的選項延後呈現。它的條件是：被延後的資訊不妨礙使用者判斷目前狀態、風險與下一步。使用者需要立即知道的錯誤不符合這個條件。

sections.heading: 四種狀態，各有一個明確下一步
paragraphs: 下圖比較各狀態應該保留的訊息。四張卡是互斥的畫面情境，不代表每次操作都會先發生錯誤再完成。沒有耗時操作時，不必為了展示而加入假的等待時間。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一個表單的四種狀態；每種狀態都要回答「現在發生什麼、接著能做什麼」。
blocks.description: 各卡片為並列比較，依標題辨識情境。

items.title: 輸入
items.body: 直接標示三個必要欄位與檢查按鈕；說明僅使用合成資料。

items.title: 處理中
items.body: 若操作確實需要等待，顯示正在檢查；避免重複提交，並提供適當的失敗或逾時處理。

items.title: 缺漏或失敗
items.body: 指出缺少文件類型，保留已填內容，讓人補齊；程式失敗則另說明可重試，不混稱資料不完整。

items.title: 完成
items.body: 說明三個必要欄位已齊全，提供預覽與匯出；不將此狀態宣稱為正式受理。

sections.heading: 用原則檢查資訊安排
paragraphs: NN/G 的易用性原則包含系統狀態可見、錯誤預防、極簡設計與錯誤復原。套用到本課時，可以問：人是否知道檢查結果？缺漏時能否避免錯誤匯出？畫面是否有和當前任務無關的資訊？錯誤提示是否說明如何修正？
例如「ERROR: INVALID」只顯示失敗；「缺少文件類型，請補填後重新檢查」則提供可行動的資訊。這是本課的原創例子；原則提供檢查方向，實際用詞仍需和目標使用者測試。

sections.heading: 兩種容易造成問題的簡化
paragraphs: 第一種是只留下綠色按鈕與打勾圖示。色覺、光線或閱讀習慣不同的人可能無法確定意義；應加上可讀文字，讓完成狀態與按鈕目的清楚。欄位也要有持續可辨識的名稱，不只依賴輸入後就消失的提示字。
第二種是把所有說明都放進收合區。補充範例適合收合，但缺漏欄位、匯出限制與系統失敗要在工作區直接看見。使用者不應為了知道為什麼無法繼續而猜測哪個設定需要展開。

sections.heading: 輸入變更後，舊結果怎麼辦
paragraphs: 假設使用者先填齊三欄，得到完整預覽，接著刪掉文件類型。如果舊報告仍可下載，介面的完成狀態已經落後於目前輸入。可以讓任何輸入變更都使舊結果失效，直到重新檢查；或在匯出時重新驗證目前資料。
選定的策略要寫進 spec.md 並加入測試。光是隱藏匯出按鈕不會自動建立後端規則；處理匯出的程式也必須拒絕缺漏輸入。UX 與業務規則要一起維持相同承諾。

sections.heading: 觀察任務，不替試用者操作
paragraphs: 給同儕一筆缺少文件類型的合成資料，請他「確認能否交接，若不行請修正並匯出」。不要先指著錯誤區告訴他答案。記錄他第一次點哪裡、是否發現缺漏、是否誤認為正式受理，以及需要哪些提示。
若他卡住，先記下發生位置與原話，再問他以為按鈕會做什麼。這些觀察可形成下一次修改假設。一次同儕試用可找出具體問題，不能據此宣稱所有人都容易使用。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或繪圖工具；使用三個合成欄位的表單。
steps: 畫出輸入、處理中、缺漏或失敗、完成四種狀態，逐一寫出使用者下一步。
把診斷設定放到次要區，保留缺漏提示與完成定義；設計輸入變更後舊結果失效的方式。
請同儕依缺漏資料完成任務，只觀察並記錄阻礙，再修正一項介面設計。
exercise.expected: 四狀態 wireframe 與至少一項有觀察依據的修正；可用 SVG 作為交付格式。
exercise.check: 請試用者用自己的話說出目前狀態與下一步；核對是否可不靠顏色、懸停或他人指引完成。
exercise.cleanup: 保留去識別化觀察與修正前後版本；丟棄真實個資及非必要錄影。

readingGuide.goal: 區分可延後呈現的設定與必須直接顯示的工作狀態。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 紙筆或繪圖工具；使用三個合成欄位的表單。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 四狀態 wireframe 與至少一項有觀察依據的修正；可用 SVG 作為交付格式。

en.summary: Arrange information around the user’s current decision: keep required fields, checking results and recovery visible, while deferring secondary settings.
objectives: Distinguish deferrable settings from work states that must remain directly visible.
Design next actions for input, processing, missing information and completion.
Observe peer tasks to check whether simplification helps.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish deferrable settings from work states that must remain directly visible.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Paper or a drawing tool and a form with three synthetic fields.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: A four-state wireframe and at least one observation-based revision, optionally delivered as SVG.

sections.heading: Identify the Decision the Main Screen Supports
paragraphs: An intake worker opening the checking site needs to decide whether data is ready for handoff. Show required fields, a check button, omissions and corrections, then a preview after completion. Polling intervals, debug output and model parameters usually do not affect that decision and can belong in secondary settings or the teaching development environment.
Processing affects whether to click again; failure affects whether to retry. Keep those states directly visible. Map decisions before positioning information when simplifying a screen.

sections.heading: Like the Main Screen of a Ticket Machine
paragraphs: Buying a ticket requires a destination, quantity and payment status. Maintenance staff may need transaction logs and connection diagnostics. Showing everything on the home screen makes passengers search through unrelated information. Hiding payment failure in settings, however, can leave them unsure whether they were charged.

Progressive disclosure defers less-used or complex options. Deferral is appropriate only when it does not obstruct judgment of current state, risk and next action. An error users need now does not meet that condition.

sections.heading: Give Each State a Clear Next Action
paragraphs: The cards compare information to retain for each state. They are mutually exclusive screen situations, not a requirement to pass through an error before completion. Do not add an artificial wait when no operation takes time.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Four States of the Same Form
blocks.description: Each state should explain what is happening and what can happen next. The cards compare alternative situations.

items.title: Input
items.body: Label the three required fields and check button directly, explaining that only synthetic data is used.

items.title: Processing
items.body: For a genuine wait, show checking status, prevent duplicate submission and provide suitable failure or timeout handling.

items.title: Missing information or failure
items.body: Identify missing document type, retain other input and allow correction. Explain retryable program failure separately from incomplete data.

items.title: Complete
items.body: State that three required fields are complete and offer preview/export. Do not imply official acceptance.

sections.heading: Use Principles to Inspect Information Arrangement
paragraphs: NN/G’s heuristics include visible system status, error prevention, minimalist design and recovery. Ask whether people know the result, missing-input export is prevented, unrelated content competes with the task and feedback explains correction.

“ERROR: INVALID” communicates failure only; “Document type is missing. Fill it in and check again” gives an action. This is an original course example. Principles guide inspection, while wording still needs testing with intended users.

sections.heading: Two Simplifications That Can Cause Problems
paragraphs: Keeping only a green button and check mark may leave people uncertain under different color perception, lighting or reading habits. Add readable text explaining completion and button purpose. Keep field names identifiable rather than relying only on placeholders that disappear after entry.

Putting every explanation in collapsible areas creates another problem. Supplementary examples may be deferred, but missing fields, export restrictions and system failures must be visible in the work area. Users should not have to guess which setting explains why they cannot continue.

sections.heading: Decide What Happens to Results After Input Changes
paragraphs: Suppose the user completes three fields, receives a complete preview and then deletes document type. An old downloadable report would make completion lag behind current input. Invalidate old results on any edit until rechecking, or revalidate current input when exporting.

Record the chosen strategy in spec.md and tests. Hiding an export button alone does not enforce a backend rule: export-processing code must also reject missing input. UX and business rules need to maintain the same promise.

sections.heading: Observe the Task Without Operating for the Participant
paragraphs: Give a peer synthetic data missing document type and ask them to check readiness for handoff, correct it if necessary and export. Do not point at the error area first. Record their first action, whether they notice the omission, confuse completeness with official acceptance or need hints.

If they become stuck, record the location and their actual words before asking what they expected the button to do. Those observations can inform the next hypothesis. One peer session can expose concrete problems, not establish usability for everyone.

exercise.environment: Paper or a drawing tool and a form with three synthetic fields.
steps: Draw input, processing, missing-information/failure and complete states, specifying the user’s next action for each.
Move diagnostics to a secondary area while retaining errors and the completion definition. Design invalidation of old results after input edits.
Have a peer perform the missing-input task. Observe and record barriers, then revise one interface decision.
exercise.expected: A four-state wireframe and at least one observation-based revision, optionally delivered as SVG.
exercise.check: Ask the participant to explain current state and next action in their own words. Check whether completion can rely on more than color, hover or another person’s guidance.
exercise.cleanup: Retain de-identified observations and before/after versions. Discard real personal data and unnecessary recordings.

zh.prompt: 為了讓主畫面簡潔，哪一項安排最合適？
options: 把缺漏錯誤藏進進階設定
只以紅色邊框表示失敗
直接顯示缺漏與修正方法，將除錯設定放到次要區
收到檢查結果前先顯示完成
rationales: 缺漏影響當下工作決定，應直接呈現。
僅靠顏色不清楚，也未說明如何修正。
當前任務所需的資訊可見，較少使用的設定延後呈現。
應依真實狀態回饋，避免誤導人提早交接。

en.prompt: Which arrangement best simplifies the main screen?
options: Hide missing-input errors in advanced settings.
Indicate failure with a red border only.
Show omissions and correction directly, placing debug settings in a secondary area.
Show completion before check results arrive.
rationales: Omissions affect the current decision and need direct feedback.
Color alone is unclear and explains no correction.
Information needed now remains visible while less-used settings are deferred.
Feedback should match actual state to avoid premature handoff.
